title: Design League
description: Design League is a three-week design competition organized by Skill&Tell: 200 participants, 4 online challenges, 1 mini hackathon, only 1 winner. Over those three weeks, participants went through four online challenges covering different parts of the design process, from branding and design systems to UI/UX, pitching ideas and building creative assets. Before each round they joined a workshop that walked them through that specific skill and gave them the tools they needed, then came the real test: a deadline and a chance to show what they've got. After each round, participants were ranked on four criteria: coherence, creativity, technique and how well they followed the guidelines. Last came the Mini Hackathon, where participants brought everything together, from their initial idea to their final assets, built a pitch deck and presented in front of the other participants and the jury. Initiatives like Design League matter more than ever now that AI makes it easy to skip learning design altogether and just take the easiest output, which is why Skill&Tell gives people a space to learn, experiment, create and compete. Because sometimes you just need a place to create.

title: AgriChallenge
description: Agri Challenge is a national AI + Agriculture hackathon where students solve real-world agronomic problems using the power of Botanics and AI. The event is built around two main challenges: Data collection & build intelligent models, and the IDEA Challenge (NEW!), a brand-new special segment for just 5 selected teams, judged not just on tech but on creative ideas. It runs 22-25 June 2025 at the Botanical Garden "Hamma" and the National Higher School of AI.

title: EUNOIA
description: EUNOIA is the first edition of a full-day innovation event focused on student well-being. Combining creativity, collaboration, and fun, it features an ideathon, inspiring talks by well-being experts, interactive activities, a cultural village, and opportunities for movement and social connection. The event aims to help students address real mental and physical health challenges, turn meaningful ideas into solutions, and build a supportive, energetic campus community.
